chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a free man performing liʿān against a female slave. He said: "Yes, if it was her master who married her to him."

key_terms.الْحُرِّ: a free man, as opposed to a slave
key_terms.يُلَاعِنُ: engages in liʿān, the formal mutual imprecation procedure between spouses

ai.seo_question: Can a free man perform liʿān with a female slave in Shia law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning liʿān between a free man and a female slave. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام affirms its validity in the case where her master was the one who gave her in marriage to him, indicating a specific legal condition tied to the marriage arrangement.
